heading: About Eton Manor
body:
Eton Manor Running Club was founded to give East London runners a welcoming, well-coached home track. What started as a handful of members training on Tuesday evenings has grown into a club of over two hundred runners of every ability.

Today we train year-round at Quarter Mile Lane, with coached track sessions, social club runs, and a full calendar of races. Whether you're aiming for your first 5K or chasing a championship time, there's a group here running at your pace.

We're proud of our community as much as our results — post-run coffee, club socials, and a genuinely welcoming atmosphere are as much a part of Eton Manor as the training itself.
